mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u.img as sender_user_img FROM im_message t LEFT JOIN base_user u ON t.sender_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = false AND t.conversation_id = #{query.conversationId} AND t.id > #{query.afterMessageId} ORDER BY t.id ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.*, u.img as sender_user_img, u.name as sender_name FROM im_message t LEFT JOIN base_user u ON t.sender_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = false AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.type = 1 AND (t.is_withdrawn = false OR t.is_withdrawn IS NULL)
AND LOWER(t.content) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{escapedKeyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT t.*, u.img as sender_user_img, u.name as sender_name FROM im_message t LEFT JOIN base_user u ON t.sender_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = false AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.type = 2 AND (t.is_withdrawn = false OR t.is_withdrawn IS NULL)
ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT t.*, u.img as sender_user_img, u.name as sender_name FROM im_message t LEFT JOIN base_user u ON t.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN base_file_save f ON t.file_id = f.id AND f.deleted = false WHERE t.deleted = false AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.type = 4 AND (t.is_withdrawn = false OR t.is_withdrawn IS NULL)
AND LOWER(f.original_filename) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{escapedKeyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '!'
AND LOWER(REPLACE(TRIM(f.ext), '.', '')) = #{fileExt}
ORDER BY t.id DESC

SELECT t.*, u.img as sender_user_img FROM im_message t LEFT JOIN base_user u ON t.sender_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = false AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND t.id < #{messageId} ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 21
